newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to lower import tariffs on 1,200 items.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to lower import tariffs on 1,200 items.

text.p: Indonesia is expected to lower import tariffs covering 1,200 product items by five percent early this year, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported on Friday.

The paper quoted director-general for tariffs and pricing, Daeng Nazier, as saying on Thursday tariffs on items currently at 15 percent and 10 percent would be lowered to 10 percent and five percent respectively.
"The lowering of the import tariffs will be implemented early this year. So just wait for the announcement from the finance minister or other related ministers," Nazier was quoted as saying.

He said import tariffs in Indonesia covered about 7,200 items and added that such tariffs would be reduced to a maximum of 10 percent by 2003, except for certain products in areas such as the automotive and chemical industries and agriculture.
The paper gave no other details and Finance Ministry officials were not immediatelly available for comment.
